observation.command: PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_production -tAc "select id, email, verified_at is not null from users where email='admin@consul.dev'"; echo "=== users count / role users ==="; PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_production -tAc "select count(*) from users"; PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_production -tAc "select email from users where email in ('admin@consul.dev','mod@consul.dev','manager@consul.dev','valuator@consul.dev','verified@consul.dev','unverified@consul.dev') order by email"; echo "=== projekts ==="; PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_production -tAc "select count(*) from projekts"; PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_production -tAc "select id, title from projekts limit 5"; echo "=== admin role record ==="; PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_production -tAc "select u.email, a.class_name from users u join administrator_roles a on a.user_id=u.id where u.email='admin@consul.dev'" 2>&1 | head -5
